name: Kanshasai
source:
Hero owes his mysterious grandfather who supported him for 20 years. To return the favor old man asks him to train a girl. But hero could not even imagine that the girl would be his best friend Yurika.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄亏欠了支持他20年的神秘祖父。为了报答老人的恩情，老人请他训练一个女孩。但英雄根本无法想象这个女孩会是他最好的朋友尤里卡。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
